title: 2013 AMC 10A Problem 20
statement: A unit square is rotated \(45^\circ\) about its center. What is the area of the region swept out by the interior of the square?

solutions.text:
Consider one quarter of the swept region and multiply its area by \(4\).

The sector has angle \(45^\circ\) and radius \(\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\), so its area is \(\frac18\pi\left(\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\right)^2=\frac{\pi}{16}\).

The two right-triangle pieces in that quarter have areas \(\frac12\cdot\frac12\cdot\frac12=\frac18\) and \(\frac12\left(\frac{\sqrt2-1}{2}\right)^2\).

Multiplying the quarter-area sum by \(4\) gives \(2-\sqrt2+\frac{\pi}{4}\).

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Work with one quadrant of the swept region
Decompose that quadrant into a sector and two right-triangle pieces
